profile.headline: Ready to Learn STEM | Computer Science | Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Like most kids, I wasn't sure which field of study I wanted to commit to, so I worked hard at every school subject. I obtained the highest GPA in my middle school, and I continued to work hard throughout high school, reaching the top of my class there as well.

It was at CAST Tech HS that I developed an interest in Computer Science, using the Linux OS and programming in Java and Python. I also dabbled in web design using the Adobe Creative Suite.

After my school administrators and my teachers recognized my work ethic, I was offered the chance to virtually interview with a co-founder of Plus One Robotics as well as the leaders of a tech foundation. Before I turned 18, I was hired as an intern for both entities, collecting data for AI training and designing websites.

I'm eager to understand others, analyze data, and discover patterns so we can design solutions to help other teams reach their goals, whether it's software, refined processes, or something entirely novel.

Key skills: Software Design/Development, GitLab, GitHub, Ubuntu Linux OS, Python, quality assurance, communication, documentation

- Develop a tool to compare and visualize the metrics and predictions of different AI models for ML operations

positions.title: Web Designer Intern
positions.description:
I worked with other interns to create two websites using WordPress. One was for the CyberTexas Foundation. The other was for the Alamo Chapter of the Air Force Association. Weekly virtual presentations were prepared to showcase the current progress of the websites.

The Air Force Association representatives said that our work clearly put their web site into the latest technology available through WordPress.  They added that we truly modernized their web site to make it more effective for their members.
